name: skill-issue
description: macOS interview assistant with local speech recognition and an encrypted web viewer.
author: Ruslan Khasanshin

scripts.lint:web: bun types:worker && bun fmt --check && oxlint && stylelint --max-warnings 0 --ignore-path .gitignore 'web/**/*.css' && shfmt -d scripts/*.sh && bunx --minimum-release-age 259200 shellcheck scripts/*.sh
scripts.lint:swift: swift format lint --strict --recursive Package.swift native tests checks/native_relay.swift scripts/quit.swift && swiftlint lint --strict --quiet && swiftc -typecheck -swift-version 6 -warnings-as-errors scripts/quit.swift
scripts.lint: bun lint:web && bun lint:swift && bun check:plist
scripts.lint:fix:web: bun types:worker && (oxlint --fix || oxlint --fix; stylelint --max-warnings 0 --fix --ignore-path .gitignore 'web/**/*.css' && bun fmt && oxlint) && shfmt -w scripts/*.sh
scripts.lint:fix:swift: swiftlint lint --fix --quiet && swift format format --in-place --recursive Package.swift native tests checks/native_relay.swift scripts/quit.swift
scripts.lint:fix: bun lint:fix:web && bun lint:fix:swift && bun lint:fix:plist
scripts.check:types: bun types:worker && bun check && bun check -p web/tsconfig.json && bun check -p relay/tsconfig.json
scripts.check:plist: plutil -lint scripts/Info.plist && plutil -convert xml1 -o - scripts/Info.plist | diff scripts/Info.plist -
scripts.check:web:local: bun lint:web && bun check:hooks && bun check:workflows && bun check:types && bun check:unused:web && bun check:vulns && bun test:coverage:web
scripts.check:swift:local: bun lint:swift && bun check:plist && bun test:coverage:swift
scripts.check:swift: bun check:swift:local && bun check:unused:swift && bun build:release && bun build:prompt-eval && bun check:integration:swift
scripts.prepare: if [ -n "${CI:-}" ] || [ "${LEFTHOOK:-}" = "0" ]; then exit 0; fi; lefthook install
